# Whiteboard

Self-hosted workspaces and editable Excalidraw scenes.

## Documentation

- [Dashboard](docs/dashboard.md): workspace navigation, original dashboard theme, scene import limits and behavior.

- [Browser collaboration](docs/browser-collaboration.md): branch-only admission, offline recovery, scoped queues, images and local undo.
- [Workspace invitations](docs/collaboration.md): branch-only invitation API, roles, registration and limits.
- [Diagram catalog](docs/diagram-catalog.md): native presets and supported input schemas.

- [Scene assets](docs/scene-assets.md): branch-only scoped upload/view, size/MIME limits, expiry and required headers.

- [Agent keys and MCP](docs/agents.md): scoped keys, transport configuration, pagination and PAT compatibility.

## Release status

Dashboard C1 is implemented on the collaboration-v2 branch and pending deployment. Custom collaboration, invitation roles, public editing and MCP are being implemented; do not assume these APIs are available until their release documentation confirms deployment.
